title: 第13章 亡命之徒杀戮开始第14章 兰天庭江南武道第一人
content_zh:
第二天，张扬开始制作飞剑符。
符箓是修仙者必学的入门技能，元气通过符笔落到符纸上，符纸便能拥有法术能力。
张扬第一次接触符箓，花了好几天，终于制作出第一张飞剑符。
这天早上，张扬正在修炼，楼下传来一声巨响。
“主人，陈天龙的人找上门了。”
妖姬跑上二楼，紧张地说道。
“来了多少人？”
“十几个，都是亡命之徒，为首的是索命。”
“你先出手，别怕，有我在。”
妖姬已经突破炼气一层，有元气托底，十几人未必对付不了。
“我试试。”
自从被张扬救下，还传了修仙功法之后，妖姬对张扬唯命是从。
她心里很清楚，无论是陈天龙，还是兰家，都不会放过她。
她唯一能倚仗的只有张扬，只能认他为主。
有主人托底，妖姬信心大增，从楼上走了下来。
“妖姬，你可真难找啊！”
人群簇拥中，走出一名染着黄发的年轻男子，嘴里叼着一根烟。
他招了招手，背后一名小弟很识趣，搬来一张椅子，他一屁股坐了下来。
“索命，陈天龙能这样对我，以后也会这样对你。”
妖姬想用反间计，让对方离心，放弃杀自己。

“你算什么东西，能跟我比吗？”
索命抽了口烟，满脸讥笑，“要文化没文化，要头脑没头脑，除了出卖肉体，你有什么能力？”
旁边一群小弟笑了起来，空气中全都是淫声笑语。
妖姬想起不堪回首的过往，脸色十分难看。
“还愣着干什么，动手。”楼上飘落一句话。
妖姬这才醒悟过来，握着匕首冲了出去。
“废了她，留活的。”
索命一声令下，一群小混混抽出武器，冲了上去。
刷刷刷！
妖姬化成一道影子，刀光剑影中，残肢纷纷掉到地上。
仅仅片刻，索命带来的十几人不是缺胳膊就是断腿，全都倒在地上。
“你怎么变得这么厉害？”
索命脸色大变，霍地站了起来，身体往后退。
妖姬什么实力，他非常清楚，在他手里走不了一分钟。
content_en:
The next day, Zhang Yang started making the flying sword talisman.
Talisman is an introductory skill that must be learned by cultivators. The vitality falls on the talisman paper through the talisman pen, and the talisman paper can have magical powers.
Zhang Yang came into contact with talismans for the first time. It took him several days to finally make his first flying sword talisman.
This morning, Zhang Yang was practicing when a loud noise came from downstairs.
"Master, Chen Tianlong's people are here."
Enchantress ran up to the second floor and said nervously.
"How many people came?"
"More than a dozen, they are all desperadoes, and the leader is seeking life."
"You strike first, don't be afraid, I'm here."
The enchantress has already broken through the first level of Qi refining, and with her vitality to support her, a dozen or so people may not be unable to deal with her.
"I'll try."
Ever since she was rescued by Zhang Yang and taught the immortal cultivation techniques, the enchantress has obeyed Zhang Yang's orders.
She knew very well that neither Chen Tianlong nor the Lan family would let her go.
The only one she can rely on is Zhang Yang, and she can only recognize him as her master.
With the support of her master, the Enchantress became more confident and walked downstairs.
"Enchantress, you are so hard to find!"
Among the crowd, a young man with yellow hair walked out, holding a cigarette in his mouth.
He waved, and a young man behind him was very smart and moved a chair, and he sat down.
"If Chen Tianlong can do this to me, he will do the same to you in the future."
The enchantress wants to use countermeasures to make the other party alienate and give up killing her.
"Who do you think you are, can you compare with me?"
Suo Ming took a puff of his cigarette, with a sneer on his face, "If you want culture but no culture, and no brains, what ability do you have except selling your body?"
A group of boys nearby laughed, and the air was filled with obscene laughter.
The Enchantress looked very ugly as she thought about the past that she couldn't bear to look back on.
"What are you still doing in a daze? Take action." A word fell from upstairs.
The enchantress finally came to her senses and rushed out holding the dagger.
"Destroy her and keep her alive."
After giving an order, a group of gangsters drew their weapons and rushed forward.
Swish, brush, brush!
The enchantress turned into a shadow, and in the shadow of the sword, the remaining limbs fell to the ground one after another.
In just a moment, the dozen or so people who had been brought in for life were either missing arms or had broken legs, and they all fell to the ground.
"How did you become so powerful?"
Suoming's expression changed drastically, Huo Di stood up and stepped back.
He knew very well what kind of strength the enchantress had, and she wouldn't be able to survive for even a minute in his hands.
